titles.title: DIFF-TRANSPORT: bounded Claude dispatch preserves explicit input and disables ambient tools/history/project context
DIFF-ADMISSION: unsupported CLI isolation and oversized normalized schemas make zero model calls
DIFF-TRANSPORT: Codex schema normalization is counted before isolation admission
DIFF-ADMISSION: isolated pipeline calls require enforcement and forward the authoritative job cap
the message of a failed claude call gives the CLI's own error text first and in full, wherever it stands in the output
a long CLI output is written whole to a file the message names, and is never cut
the API's refusal of a request is not retried as transient; an overloaded or rate-limited call still is
a long output with no envelope keeps the error output in the message, and the file is private and old files are removed
whether a failure is retried is decided on what the CLI said, not on figures elsewhere in its output
the provider itself throws that error for a claude and a codex CLI that exit non-zero, once, with a long output in the default directory

a timed-out CLI child is killed with its process group, so a grandchild it started is gone
a CLI child that exits 0 leaving a background process holding its pipes resolves with exit code 0 and the background process is gone
completeStructured and complete run the CLI in opts.cwd when it is given
completeStructured without opts.cwd runs the CLI in the inherited working directory
a structured call honours its own timeoutMs, so a silent CLI is killed at the caller's limit, not the provider default
a codex run that narrates before answering yields its last agent message to completeStructured and complete
vibeLastAssistantText: bare array, wrapped messages, string content, no assistant
complete() runs `vibe -p --output text` with the prompt on stdin and the model pinned via VIBE_ACTIVE_MODEL
complete() without a model leaves VIBE_ACTIVE_MODEL unset (the CLI default applies)
completeStructured() parses the last assistant message of the json output and validates it against the schema
completeStructured() retries with a feedback note when the answer is not valid JSON, then succeeds
completeStructured() surfaces a stable error after retries are exhausted
runEditSession() runs headless with --auto-approve inside the repo cwd
runReviewSession() restricts tools to read_file + the insrc MCP tools and validates the schema-shaped answer
a non-zero vibe exit is a CliExitError naming vibe; a transient 429 is retried on a fresh run
